in_sanskrit.name: Vikee
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Bringer of Victory
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Vikee एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Vikee is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vijay', which means 'victory'. This name is given to a child who is believed to bring victory and success in all aspects of life. It is a powerful and unique name that instills a sense of courage and strength.
